Question
========
A graph shows the income share of the top 1% in a country over time. Which statement is correct?

Answerlist
----------
* It shows relative inequality within a country
* It shows absolute inequality between countries
* It shows horizontal inequality
* It shows multidimensional poverty

Solution
========
An income share is a relative measure, and it refers to the distribution within one country.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
